newsitem.title: USA: Secom General sees profit in each FY97 qtr.
newsitem.headline: Secom General sees profit in each FY97 qtr.

text.p: Secom General Corp said Monday it expects each quarter for fiscal 1997, which began October 1, to be profitable as new businesses come on line.
"Profit improvements will occur during the year as new business comes on line and as operational efficiencies are realized," Secom chief financial officer David Marczak also said in a news release.
The company Monday also reported a loss of $144,700, or $0.01 a share for the fourth quarter ended September 30, compared with a profit of $426,300, or $0.10 a share a year ago.
Marczak said a significant profit contribution is expected this year from Secom's newest subsidiary, Milford Manufacturing Corp, which was acquired effective November 1.
The parts and tooling maker also said it appointed Brian Chichila as vice president of operations for its Uniflow unit.

"With significant new sales orders coming on line later in the fiscal year at our Uniflow cold forming/forging unit ... we are preparing to take Uniflow's cold forming/forging technology and related secondary machining capability to a profitable level," Secom's chief executive Robert Clemente said in a news release.
Secom shares rose 1/4 to 2-7/8 on Nasdaq Monday.
